# Code Review Skill

## Security Review Checklist
- [ ] Check for SQL injection vectors
- [ ] Validate input sanitization
- [ ] Look for exposed credentials or secrets
- [ ] Review authentication/authorization logic
- [ ] Check for XSS vulnerabilities in web code

## Performance Review
- [ ] Identify O(n²) or worse algorithmic complexity
- [ ] Look for unnecessary database queries in loops
- [ ] Check for proper caching strategies
- [ ] Review memory allocation patterns
- [ ] Suggest lazy evaluation where applicable

## Code Style and Maintainability
- [ ] Check naming conventions
- [ ] Look for excessively long functions (>50 lines)
- [ ] Identify code duplication
- [ ] Verify appropriate error handling
- [ ] Check for missing or inadequate comments

## Best Practices
- [ ] Follow SOLID principles
- [ ] Use appropriate design patterns
- [ ] Ensure proper separation of concerns
- [ ] Verify test coverage for new code
